Script.name: Mudlet base UI
Script.script:
-- Mudlet base UI: a small starter interface for games that support GMCP. -- Nothing is created until the game actually sends data: vitals gauges are -- built from gmcp.Char.Vitals (only for the fields that exist), the map and -- chat windows appear alongside them. Chat comes from gmcp.Comm.Channel.Text -- when the game offers it; for everything else, additive triggers capture the -- common chat-line shapes (tells, says, channels) shared by most games. -- Type "baseui" for options; "baseui hide" removes it until "baseui show".
BaseUI = BaseUI or {} BaseUI.gauges = BaseUI.gauges or {} BaseUI.usedGaugeSlots = BaseUI.usedGaugeSlots or 0 BaseUI.chatTriggerIds = BaseUI.chatTriggerIds or {} BaseUI.recentCaptures = BaseUI.recentCaptures or {}
local settingsFile = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/base_ui_settings.lua"
local gaugeSlots = { "86%", "93%" }
local gaugeBack = [[background-color: QLinearGradient( x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: 0, y2: 1, stop: 0 #3a3a3a, stop: 1 #1c1c1c); border: 1px solid black; border-radius: 4px;]]
local gaugeDefs = { hp = { front = [[background-color: QLinearGradient( x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: 0, y2: 1, stop: 0 #7ddf7d, stop: 0.5 #2e8b2e, stop: 1 #1f6e1f); border: 1px solid #0c2f0c; border-radius: 4px;]], }, mp = { front = [[background-color: QLinearGradient( x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: 0, y2: 1, stop: 0 #7db8df, stop: 0.5 #2e6a8b, stop: 1 #1f4d6e); border: 1px solid #0c1f2f; border-radius: 4px;]], }, }
local vitalsList = { { key = "hp", label = "HP", current = "hp", max = "maxhp" }, { key = "mp", label = "MP", current = "mp", max = "maxmp" }, }
-- generic chat capture for games without GMCP chat: trigger shapes most games -- share. Capture is additive - the matched line is copied into the chat window -- with its colours and never removed from the main one. -- a "[tag]", "(tag)" or "< tag |" prefix only counts as chat when its first -- word is a well-known channel name - extend this list to cover more games BaseUI.chatChannelNames = { chat = true, say = true, tell = true, tells = true, gtell = true, newbie = true, newbies = true, gossip = true, grats = true, gratz = true, congrats = true, ooc = true, ic = true, clan = true, guild = true, order = true, house = true, city = true, market = true, auction = true, trade = true, talk = true, ask = true, answer = true, question = true, questions = true, music = true, quote = true, roleplay = true, rp = true, imm = true, group = true, party = true, team = true, shout = true, yell = true, form = true, town = true, }
-- entries with tagged = true capture a channel tag that must pass the list above local chatPatterns = { { regex = [=[^\w[\w'-]* tells you\b[^,:]{0,30}(?::|,?\s*['"])]=] }, { regex = [=[^You tell [\w'-]+[^,:]{0,30}(?::|,?\s*['"])]=] }, { regex = [=[^You tell the (?:group|formation)\b]=] }, { regex = [=[^\w[\w'-]* whispers to you\b[^,:]{0,30}(?::|,?\s*['"])]=] }, { regex = [=[^\w[\w'-]* tells the (?:group|formation)\b]=] }, { regex = [=[^\w[\w'-]* (?:says|asks|exclaims)[^,:]{0,20},?\s*['"]]=] }, { regex = [=[^You (?:say|ask|exclaim)[^,:]{0,20},?\s*['"]]=] }, { regex = [=[^\w[\w'-]* (?:yells|shouts)[^,:]{0,20},?\s*['"]]=] }, { regex = [=[^You (?:yell|shout)[^,:]{0,20},?\s*['"]]=] }, { regex = [=[^\[([\w][\w -]{0,18})\]]=], tagged = true }, { regex = [=[^\(([\w -]{1,18})\)[:\s]]=], tagged = true }, { regex = [=[^< ?([\w -]{1,18}) ?\|]=], tagged = true }, }
function BaseUI.routeChatLine() -- gmcpChat means the trigger layer is retired: killing a trigger does not -- stop it firing on lines from the batch already being processed -- several patterns can match the same line - copy it only once local lineNumber = getLineNumber() if not BaseUI.chat or BaseUI.gmcpChat or lineNumber == BaseUI.lastChatLine then return end BaseUI.lastChatLine = lineNumber selectCurrentLine() copy() BaseUI.chat:appendBuffer() deselect() table.insert(BaseUI.recentCaptures, { text = line, time = getEpoch() }) if #BaseUI.recentCaptures > 10 then table.remove(BaseUI.recentCaptures, 1) end end
function BaseUI.routeTaggedChatLine() local tag = matches[2]:match("(%S+)") if tag and BaseUI.chatChannelNames[tag:lower()] then BaseUI.routeChatLine() end end
function BaseUI.createChatTriggers() if not BaseUI.chat or BaseUI.settings.hidden or BaseUI.gmcpChat or next(BaseUI.chatTriggerIds) then return end for _, pattern in ipairs(chatPatterns) do table.insert(BaseUI.chatTriggerIds, tempRegexTrigger(pattern.regex, pattern.tagged and BaseUI.routeTaggedChatLine or BaseUI.routeChatLine)) end end
function BaseUI.killChatTriggers() for _, id in ipairs(BaseUI.chatTriggerIds) do killTrigger(id) end BaseUI.chatTriggerIds = {} end
function BaseUI.loadSettings() BaseUI.settings = {} if io.exists(settingsFile) and not pcall(table.load, settingsFile, BaseUI.settings) then -- corrupted settings file - start over with the defaults BaseUI.settings = {} end end
function BaseUI.saveSettings() table.save(settingsFile, BaseUI.settings) end
function BaseUI.build() if BaseUI.container then return end BaseUI.container = Adjustable.Container:new({ name = "BaseUI", x = "75%", y = "0%", width = "25%", height = "100%", attached = "right", titleText = "Mudlet UI", titleTxtColor = "white", adjLabelstyle = "background-color: rgba(25,25,25,100%); border: 1px solid grey;", -- the container's own session persistence can restore a hidden, detached -- state that is impossible to bring back reliably - we persist the only -- choice that matters (hidden or not) ourselves autoLoad = false, autoSave = false, }) BaseUI.map = Geyser.Mapper:new({ name = "BaseUI_map", x = "1%", y = "0%", width = "98%", height = "44%", }, BaseUI.container) BaseUI.chat = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = "BaseUI_chat", x = "1%", y = "45%", width = "98%", height = "40%", autoWrap = true, color = "black", fontSize = 10, }, BaseUI.container) BaseUI.chat:echo("Tells, says and channel chat from the game will be collected here.\n") BaseUI.createChatTriggers() -- the container remembers its own hidden/detached state from the previous -- session (it saves on exit) - our setting says it should be visible, so -- override whatever it restored if not BaseUI.settings.hidden then BaseUI.container:show() if not BaseUI.container.attached then BaseUI.container:attachToBorder("right") end end BaseUI.maybeAnnounce() end
function BaseUI.ensureGauge(key) local gauge = BaseUI.gauges[key] if gauge then return gauge end local slot = gaugeSlots[BaseUI.usedGaugeSlots + 1] local def = gaugeDefs[key] if not slot or not def then return nil end BaseUI.usedGaugeSlots = BaseUI.usedGaugeSlots + 1 gauge = Geyser.Gauge:new({ name = "BaseUI_" .. key .. "_gauge", x = "2%", y = slot, width = "96%", height = "6%", strict = true, }, BaseUI.container) gauge:setStyleSheet(def.front, gaugeBack) gauge:setFgColor("white") gauge:setAlignment("center") BaseUI.gauges[key] = gauge return gauge end
function BaseUI.updateVitals() if BaseUI.settings.hidden then return end local vitals = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals if type(vitals) ~= "table" then return end BaseUI.build() for _, stat in ipairs(vitalsList) do -- some games send numbers as strings, hence the tonumber() local current, max = tonumber(vitals[stat.current]), tonumber(vitals[stat.max]) if current and max and max > 0 then local gauge = BaseUI.ensureGauge(stat.key) if gauge then gauge:setValue(current, max, string.format("%s %d/%d", stat.label, current, max)) end end end end
function BaseUI.addChatMessage() local message = gmcp and gmcp.Comm and gmcp.Comm.Channel and gmcp.Comm.Channel.Text if type(message) ~= "table" or type(message.text) ~= "string" then return end -- the game sends chat over GMCP and usually echoes it as plain text too - -- retire the generic triggers for this session so lines are not captured twice BaseUI.gmcpChat = true BaseUI.killChatTriggers() if BaseUI.settings.hidden then return end BaseUI.build() -- the first GMCP messages race their own plain-text echoes: an echo can be -- trigger-captured moments before this handler learns the game speaks GMCP -- chat, so drop a message whose text was just captured as a line if next(BaseUI.recentCaptures) then local plain = message.text:gsub("\27%[[0-9;:]*m", "") local now = getEpoch() for i = #BaseUI.recentCaptures, 1, -1 do local capture = BaseUI.recentCaptures[i] if now - capture.time > 2 then table.remove(BaseUI.recentCaptures, i) elseif capture.text == plain then table.remove(BaseUI.recentCaptures, i) return end end end BaseUI.chat:decho(ansi2decho(message.text) .. "\n") end
-- ask the game to send channel text over GMCP (not all games do so unprompted) function BaseUI.enableChannelCapture(_, protocol) if protocol ~= "GMCP" or BaseUI.settings.hidden then return end gmod.enableModule("BaseUI", "Comm.Channel") end
function BaseUI.maybeAnnounce() if BaseUI.settings.announced then return end -- respect the first-run UI tour: hold the introduction until it is done if mudlet and mudlet.uiTourPending then registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysUiTourFinished", "BaseUI.announce", true) return end BaseUI.announce() end
function BaseUI.announce() if BaseUI.settings.announced then return end BaseUI.settings.announced = true BaseUI.saveSettings() cecho("\n<cyan>[ Mudlet UI ] Built you a starter interface from what your game supports - health bars, map and chat.\n") cecho("<cyan>[ Mudlet UI ] Drag its title bar to move it, right-click for options, or type <yellow>baseui hide<cyan> to remove it.<reset>\n") end
function BaseUI.hide() BaseUI.settings.hidden = true BaseUI.saveSettings() BaseUI.killChatTriggers() if BaseUI.container then BaseUI.container:hide() BaseUI.container:adjustBorder() end cecho("\n<cyan>[ Mudlet UI ] Hidden - type <yellow>baseui show<cyan> to bring it back.<reset>\n") end
function BaseUI.show() BaseUI.settings.hidden = false BaseUI.saveSettings() if type(gmcp) == "table" and next(gmcp) then gmod.enableModule("BaseUI", "Comm.Channel") end BaseUI.updateVitals() BaseUI.createChatTriggers() if BaseUI.container then BaseUI.container:show() if not BaseUI.container.attached then BaseUI.container:attachToBorder("right") end cecho("\n<cyan>[ Mudlet UI ] Shown.<reset>\n") else cecho("\n<cyan>[ Mudlet UI ] It will appear as soon as the game sends character data.<reset>\n") end end
function BaseUI.alias(input) input = (input or ""):trim():lower() if input == "hide" then BaseUI.hide() elseif input == "show" then BaseUI.show() else local state if BaseUI.settings.hidden then state = "hidden" elseif BaseUI.container then state = "shown" else state = "waiting for game data" end cecho("\n<cyan>[ Mudlet UI ] A starter interface built from your game's data (currently " .. state .. ").\n") cecho("<cyan>[ Mudlet UI ] <yellow>baseui hide<cyan> - hide it (remembered between sessions)\n") cecho("<cyan>[ Mudlet UI ] <yellow>baseui show<cyan> - bring it back<reset>\n") end end
BaseUI.loadSettings()
registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Vitals", "BaseUI.updateVitals") registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Comm.Channel.Text", "BaseUI.addChatMessage") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysProtocolEnabled", "BaseUI.enableChannelCapture")
